The Associate – People & Organization supports key P&O activities across recruitment, manpower planning, employee engagement, learning and development, performance management, policies, and P&O initiatives.
q: Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
Up to 2 years of experience in People & Organization, HR, recruitment, or a related function.
Good understanding of recruitment and general P&O processes.
Ability to manage priorities, work under pressure, and maintain accuracy.
r: Support recruitment activities and coordinate with external recruitment partners.
Assist with manpower planning to ensure business staffing needs are met.
Support the implementation of P&O policies, procedures, and processes.
Coordinate employee engagement surveys, events, and team-building activities.
Support learning, development, and performance management initiatives.
Prepare accurate P&O reports related to recruitment, training, performance, and other initiatives.
Support the implementation of People & Organization projects and programs.
Ensure compliance with P&O policies, procedures, and applicable requirements.
